items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Cater's in Liberty. When he died. With the Ogdens. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, that's where his people stay there.

ctx.x: Yeah, I talked to one of Dad's little cousin there. Vincent. Mm-hmm. Yeah, he's a great guy.
Yeah, well, you know, he used to live right down the corner. Cater's in Liberty. When he died. With the Ogdens.
Well, that's where his people stay there. I seen a little fella there yesterday. Mm-hmm. I got home. Mm-hmm. He got there. Looked like it's all in their family.
